product: Genie Migrate can convert T-SQL to Lakeflow pipelines (Beta)
tagline: Genie Migrate can convert T SQL scripts from SQL Server and Azure Synapse dedicated SQL pools into Lakeflow pipelines.
what_it_does: Genie Migrate can convert T SQL scripts from SQL Server and Azure Synapse dedicated SQL pools into Lakeflow pipelines. This target framework is in Beta. In a T SQL migration project, choose the Spark Declarative Pipelines target framework, organize your files into groups, and choose a catalog and schema for each group.
why_it_matters: Supported source dialects and target frameworks Genie Migrate converts the following SQL dialects: T SQL Snowflake SQL Redshift SQL Oracle BigQuery Teradata When you create a migration project for a SQL dialect, choose one of the following target frameworks: DBSQL: ANSI compliant Databricks SQL queries.
plain_summary: Genie Migrate can convert T SQL scripts from SQL Server and Azure Synapse dedicated SQL pools into Lakeflow pipelines. This target framework is in Beta.
key_takeaway: Genie Migrate can convert T SQL scripts from SQL Server and Azure Synapse dedicated SQL pools into Lakeflow pipelines.
